summary: First testing iteration of Prosper platform MVP. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases passed (100%) covering health, auth, dashboard, organizations, onboarding, compliance, funds, products, positions, treasury, transactions (+mint), reconciliation (+resolve), integrations (apps/keys/webhooks + create+revoke key), alerts (+resolve), reports, audit logs, users. Frontend: login page, cookie-based auth, dashboard KPIs, demo banner, env switcher, all 17 sidebar pages render without errors, Transactions (120 rows) + Reconciliation (120 rows) load from API, Client Portal /portal renders with different nav set, Logout redirects to /login. Demo data auto-seeded correctly (5 orgs, 2 funds, 5 products, 35 positions, 120 tx, 120 recon, 6 apps, 3 keys, 3 webhooks, 4 alerts, 12 reports).

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial render — cosmetic only, charts render correctly after layout settles. Consider adding explicit minHeight to parent to silence warnings.

action_items: (Optional) Nav data-testid is derived from label and includes '&' for 'Users & Roles' -> 'nav-users-&-roles' (fragile). Consider explicit slugification or stable testids like 'nav-users', 'nav-audit'.
(Optional) Silence Recharts width(-1) warning by setting a minHeight on chart parent container.
critical_code_review_comments: routers.py is a single large file per the handoff note — splitting into /backend/routers/*.py by domain would improve maintainability (dir exists but appears empty).
MongoDB _id exclusion verified across /auth/me, /organizations, /compliance/queue responses — good.
prosperTxId uniqueness verified across 120 transactions — good.
API key create returns plaintext ONCE in field `api_key_plaintext` — correct behavior; ensure this field is NOT persisted (not tested here).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows work; minor testid slug quirk)

seed_data_creation: None created by tests beyond a transient API key (scoped TEST_key, revoked within test). One reconciliation record was marked resolved during test — idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_prosper_api.py (pytest, 29 tests, all pass). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend: sidebar data-testid pattern is `nav-<label-lowercased-hyphenated>` — note 'Users & Roles' becomes 'nav-users-&-roles' and 'Audit Log' becomes 'nav-audit-log'. Session cookie name is `session_token`, domain finance-control-215.preview.emergentagent.com. Portal at /portal, backoffice at /app, login at /login.
